title: Pick SidePlay's new look
question: Three real mockups, all red and white with small black accents. Pick the one to build, or re-roll for three new ones.

options.label: Shop Wall
options.lineage: The sports-shop display wall: white pegboard, red hooks, swing tags
options.thesis: The homepage is SidePlay's own display wall: real products hang on red hooks, every one with its price on a swinging red tag.
options.viewport: Pegboard fills the first screen with scooter, racket, rope, rim and backpack hanging at different heights, each with a red price tag; a hanging red aisle sign holds the headline and search.
options.risk: Busy if too many items hang at once; the wall must stay a few heroes, with the full catalog below.

raised.raise: Depth only from overlap: tags, hooks and products are flat layers, no fake shading.
One hero product anchors each department section, smaller items orbit it.
Counts change as visible events: filter counts and prices flip when they update.
Every tag carries the same banded facts in the same place: price, size, code.
The wall stays whole at every size; panels restack around it on phones.

options.label: Running Track
options.lineage: A red tartan running track seen from above
options.thesis: Seven red track lanes are the seven departments; the white infield holds the headline, search and featured gear.
options.viewport: Lanes 1 to 7 sweep in a curve across the screen, each named for a department with its count and starting price; the infield holds headline, search and three priced products.
options.risk: Sporty move many sports brands use; close in feel to the court you didn't like.

options.label: Flat Tiles
options.lineage: Metro-style flat tiles and giant cropped lowercase
options.thesis: No decoration at all: giant words and flat red tiles; tiles flip to show products and prices.
options.viewport: Giant lowercase 'gear for every game' cropped off the right edge over a grid of flat red and white tiles holding departments and priced products.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: departments become tiles and prices live on them; very clear, less sporty character.
options.risk: Can feel like an app dashboard rather than a sports shop.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.case: Fuses poorly: food world foreign to sport.
options.kept: The same banded facts on every label.

options.label: Layered Papercut
options.thesis: Flat paper layers pasted into a roundel.
options.case: Fuses poorly: folk craft, not sport.
options.kept: Depth from overlap only, never shading.

options.label: Candy Poster
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream and candy colours break the red/white pin.
options.kept: One emblematic figure anchors each section.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark lab instrument, the black you rejected.

options.label: Mini Room
options.case: Fuses poorly: pastel social profile, not a store.
options.kept: The scene stays whole at every size.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white sports store: big action photo banner, category tiles, product grid, red buttons.
canonCard.viewport: Full-width action photo with headline and Shop button, then a row of category tiles.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other sports shop. (No mockup: credits only cover three.)
